text:
Grace L: Quick alert 1k webinar signups overnight pushed HubSpot -> router pipeline into a retry storm. We ended up with ~30 leads in pending-enrich >1h. Biz SLA is 30m. Need a short-lived mitigation.
Noah H: Saw it. HS webhooks kept returning 503/timeout, SFDC connector also throttled. Our router waits for enrich by design so round-robin skipped these.
Eleni S: Can we add an "assign-lane" fallback that nicks leads after a short grace period and routes to a regional overflow pool? e.g., for tag:webinar pick overflow-emea/overflow-apac based on tz. Must be reversible.
Grace L: Yes but safety: mark fallback with header X-Claim-Fallback=true and ttl so sales knows it's temporary. Avoid duplicate owners and limit swaps.
Noah H: Router is idempotent so swap is safe. Proposal: grace=90s for webinar tag, fallback targets by tz, swap_cap=1, ttl=25m. Add metric fallback_count, swap_count, duplicate_claims.
Eleni S: Also scope to sources [zoom, hopin] and exclude company_tier=enterprise to avoid touching big deals. Feature-flag ff.assign_lane.webinar=true.
Grace L: Good. Can we make the tz mapping resilient? If tz missing, fallback to utc->overflow-na.
Noah H: Pseudocode I mocked:```
if (lead.tags.includes('webinar') && lead.source in ['zoom','hopin'] && !lead.enterprise && now - enrich.requested_at > 90000 && !lead.flags.assign_lane) {
  lead.flags.assign_lane = true
  let pool = mapTZToOverflow(lead.tz || 'UTC')
  enqueueAssign(lead, pool, {header:'X-Claim-Fallback:true', ttl_ms:1500000})
}
// on enrich callback
if (enrich.arrived && lead.current_owner != enrich.suggested && lead.swap_count < 1) {
  replaceOwner(lead, enrich.suggested)
  lead.swap_count += 1
}
```
Eleni S: I'll open routing-config PR and add the ff. Also add canary window 5% for 1h then promote if no duplicate_claims.
Grace L: Ops please add alerts: page if unowned_leads_by_tag[webinar] > 10 for 30m and if duplicate_claims > 2 in 1h. Deck of metrics for postmortem: time_to_first_claim, fallback_count, swap_rate.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by Eleni S at 2024-10-05T05:10:00Z for assign-lane-webinar - watch #deploys
Noah H: I'll run a replay with the webinar CSV and inject webhook timeouts to validate swap behavior. Snippet: `python tools/replay_leads.py --file webinar_big.csv --delay 120 --fail-webhook`
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 2024-10-05T05:20:00Z - routing.assign_lane.canary
Eleni S: PR: https://git.redwood/routing-configs/pull/612 - includes tz->overflow mapping, ff, ttl, swap_cap=1. Tests green.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed at 2024-10-05T05:30:00Z - success
Noah H: Replay results: fallback_count=42, swap_count=6, duplicates=0. Median time_to_first_claim improved 54m->7m for simulated load.
Grace L: Nice. Keep canary for 2h, monitor metrics. If stable, we'll enable for the weekend webinar and follow up with a permanent fix for the HS/SF connectors. Please post a short one-paragraph note to #sales explaining X-Claim-Fallback semantics.
Eleni S: Will do. Thanks team :rocket:
